_about: Catalog of Ross's city texture packs (2026-10-08). Both sheets are 1024x1024 with the same layout (checked by edge structure; no cell shifted, so no rect_override is needed). rect = [x, y, w, h] in sheet pixels. kind: floor, wall, trim, door, prop_face, sign or decal. tiles_seamlessly (clean sheet; tiles_seamlessly_busted for the busted sheet) is an edge-continuity test run by scripts/tools/slice_city_texture_atlas.gd --measure: true only for floor/wall/trim tiles whose opposite edges match on both axes. Doors, prop faces, signs and decals are single-use pieces. tiles_x / tiles_y say which axis alone repeats. seam holds the raw numbers. Pick a look per tile with variants (clean, busted). The tool slices both sheets into the tile_dir of each variant. The sheets and tiles are Ross's art: never edit them.
texel_density_start: 128 px tile = 1.0 m (128 texels per metre) as the starting point; 64 px tiles = 0.5 m.
